rationale: Prespecified score derived from IPMK-HDAC3-MMP barrier-axis biology and applied as a mucosal injury/remodeling readout in human bulk biopsies.
interpretation_boundary: Not interpreted as pathway-specific HDAC3 activity, InsP6 exposure, protein localization, or barrier permeability.

rationale: Tests whether the clinical signal is dominated by matrix metalloproteinase-associated mucosal injury and tissue remodeling.
interpretation_boundary: High signal may reflect stromal and myeloid inflammatory remodeling rather than epithelial-specific biology.

rationale: Tests the contribution of the upstream regulatory genes used to motivate the score.
interpretation_boundary: Bulk mucosal expression may have limited dynamic range and does not measure enzyme activity or chromatin occupancy.

rationale: Tests the junctional component of the prespecified score while preserving the injury-aligned CLDN2 direction.
interpretation_boundary: CLDN2 is context-dependent and should not be treated as a generic tight-junction restoration marker.

rationale: Benchmarks the score against an established inflammatory nonresponse axis in IBD mucosa.
interpretation_boundary: Comparator for signal overlap, not a replacement clinical assay.

rationale: Benchmarks the score against a compact inflammatory-response comparator available in several cohorts.
interpretation_boundary: Used to test independence from generic inflammation; gene availability differs by platform.

rationale: Provides a broader inflammation comparator without claiming use of a licensed proprietary gene set.
interpretation_boundary: Named as Hallmark-like because the analysis uses an openly documented compact gene list.

rationale: Tests whether associations track stromal remodeling and wound-repair programs common in inflamed IBD mucosa.
interpretation_boundary: Bulk-expression comparator cannot assign patient-level cell fractions.

rationale: Tests whether the score behaves similarly to neutrophil/myeloid mucosal inflammation.
interpretation_boundary: Bulk-expression comparator is not cell deconvolution.
